    level="1"
    right="Item 8"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Globe of Shrouds](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2604)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Censer" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=500" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Revelation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=138" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 123

**Price** 500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The body of this censer is made of transparent crystal banded with dark iron. This globe hangs from a sturdy chain attached to a simple steel rod with a smooth grip.

**Activate—Light Incense
** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))**Cost** incense worth at least 5 gp; **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** As you light the incense, barely visible smoke issues from the censer in a hazy 20-foot emanation. Creatures that are in the haze or later enter it are wreathed in wisps of smoke; these wisps last while the creature is in the smoke's aura and until the start of its next turn if it leaves the haze. An ally in the aura is [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=4) and gains a +2 status bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks. Any enemy in the aura that is or becomes [invisible](/Conditions.aspx?ID=26) appears as a translucent shape to you and your allies—it's no longer [hidden](/Conditions.aspx?ID=22), but it remains concealed.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
